payload.name: Extract Explicit Collaboration Agreements
payload.description: When two participants explicitly agree or decide to collaborate on a shared activity or content, extract it as a memory candidate, even if the agreement is stated enthusiastically or in casual wording.
content: During extraction, treat an explicit mutual agreement to collaborate on a shared activity (e.g., creating content, working on a project, managing accounts) as a durable event or relationship memory candidate.
Capture the collaborators, the agreed activity, and the date/time of the agreement from the message or session timestamp.
When the agreement is confirmed in a later message after earlier offers or interest, the final confirming message is sufficient evidence; create one candidate for the decision.
Stop after capturing the agreement; do not infer outcomes, add unspoken tasks, or create separate memories for every enthusiastic reply.

solves: Construction agents sometimes fail to persist explicit agreements to collaborate when they are expressed in casual or enthusiastic language at the end of a multi-turn discussion, even though earlier offers and advice were captured. This Skill ensures mutual collaboration decisions are extracted as event or relationship memories with the parties, the agreed activity, and the timestamp.
